sentences: The respondents had a clear view: Canada needs a dual approach to skills development involving broad digital literacy for all citizens and advanced AI expertise for specialized roles.
Respondents called for integrating AI education across K–12 and post-secondary curricula, offering short, stackable credentials, and investing in lifelong learning.
Public infrastructure must ensure equitable access to these opportunities.
Critical thinking, ethical reasoning and interdisciplinary skills were emphasized over narrow technical training.
Respondents urged Canada to develop a national AI literacy strategy, workplace training programs and public campaigns to demystify AI.
Concerns include job displacement, environmental harm and cognitive dependency, reinforcing the need for human-centred education.
